https://www.fieldkitforum.net/boards

Home | Reviews | Boards | Contact

Callum Devereux [8 February, 10:15 A.M.]
Hello, all. I’m starting a new site-survey job shortly and need to buy a dependable rugged tablet. Any recommendations?

Simone Achterberg [8 February, 4:40 P.M.]
I’d strongly recommend the Vantor T9. It has the quickest processor available and comes with a lot of useful survey software already installed. However, be warned that it’s rather heavy, so it might not be the best option if you travel frequently.

Callum Devereux [8 February, 8:22 P.M.]
That doesn’t bother me. I’ll be working from home and at a nearby coffee shop for the whole contract.

Marcus Boateng [9 February, 9:05 A.M.]
If the screen matters to you, take a look at the Clarion View. The display is superb in bright sunlight. The one drawback is that the battery lasts only about four hours.

Delphine Ruiz [9 February, 11:30 A.M.]
I agree the Vantor T9 is powerful, but it costs a great deal more than similar models. I personally prefer the Halden Field 5. It’s remarkably light, the battery runs all day, and it has the best warranty in the sector. If anything goes wrong, you simply take it to a service centre.

Callum Devereux [9 February, 12:48 P.M.]
That’s reassuring. Good after-sales assistance is what matters most to me. I’ll go with the Halden Field 5.
